mcp_evidence.notes: The local MCP handshake passed (resources, tools, graph_statistics, describe_module, describe_contract, impact_analysis, and the generated-write rejection). Client-use verification of a restarted AI client was not reproducible in this environment; discovery claims are therefore not marked PASSED.

tests.notes: All 51 tests pass. The 4 system tests were initially blocked by the missing Syncfusion EJ2 trial assets (bin/extract_syncfusion_assets); after extracting vendor/javascript/syncfusion and vendor/assets/syncfusion from the trial zip, all 4 pass. Two test bugs were also fixed: the account-menu <details> must be opened before clicking Sign out, and requester scoping is asserted against a request owned by a different user.

baseline_comparison.notes: The 6 failures are pre-existing platform failures unchanged by this work. Extracting the Syncfusion EJ2 assets resolved 8 of the baseline's 30 errors (the platform's own EJ2 showcase system tests), bringing errors from 30 down to 22; the remaining 22 errors are pre-existing platform issues. All 51 application tests pass.

steps.repository_intelligence_validate: blocked (12 pre-existing missing documentation files in the starter skeleton)

ci_status.notes: bin/repository-intelligence validate aborts because the Application Starter skeleton declares 12 platform-owned documentation files (docs/examples/README.md, docs/certifications/epic-9.md, docs/validation/*.md) in config/ai/documentation.yml that were never committed in the single bootstrap commit. These are platform-owned files outside the application-adoption boundary and are not part of this work. All remaining CI steps pass individually.

undocumented_context_steps.discovery: GridEngine::Catalog.scope_for(key, user:, organization:) requires keyword arguments; the registration scope lambda must accept user:, organization: and tolerate extra **.
GridEngine::Definition#columns is a Hash keyed by column name, not an Array; the HtmlRenderer is driven from the definition, not the relation.
Ui::BadgeComponent variants are neutral/primary/success/warning/danger. The 'ui-badge--info' variant assumed during authoring does not exist.
Organization is a protected model with no service_requests association; a new record must be built as ServiceRequest.new(organization:), never @organization.service_requests.new.
Grid index actions must call authorize!(@organization, :show?) in addition to the record-scoped policy; the grid scope alone does not deny a non-member.

undocumented_context_steps.topic: CSRF and session rotation in HTTP verification
undocumented_context_steps.discovery: Rails rotates the session on login, invalidating the login-page token for subsequent form posts; raw Net::HTTP verification of write flows requires a fresh token per session.
ActionDispatch::IntegrationTest reserves @request for the Rack request object; a domain instance variable named @request silently corrupts generated URLs.
Organization routes use the numeric primary key in URLs (to_param is not overridden); seeded slugs are not used in path helpers.
A member action added later (attach) must be added to the set_service_request before_action list; missing coverage yields a NilClass policy lookup.
ServiceRequest#status defaults to 'open' via the schema column default, and in_progress->resolved is a legal transition; the transition validator only runs on update.
Extensions::Runtime does not expose the sealed registry post-boot; capability resolution requires rebuilding an in-memory configuration and Loader, or a documented fallback table.

known_limitations: The Syncfusion EJ2 trial assets are now committed in vendor/ (extracted via bin/extract_syncfusion_assets); they are licensed trial assets, not the full licensed package.
The SLA extension is committed with enabled: false to satisfy the platform disabled-default contract; the capability is proven through the documented in-memory enablement consumer path.
The platform's own 6 baseline test failures and 22 errors are pre-existing and unrelated to this work.

findings.title: Application pages are unreachable from the platform navigation
findings.observed: Service Desk Lite routes (e.g. /organizations/63/service_requests) are registered only in application/config/routes/application.rb and render correctly at their direct URL. The platform navigation (Dashboard, Organizations, Grid Engine, Component Showcase, EJ2 Components) is hardcoded in the protected layout (app/views/layouts/application.html.erb) and the organization show page links only to the platform Customers feature. There is no documented application-owned extension point to contribute navigation items or organization-scoped links, so an application user cannot discover application pages without typing the URL.
findings.recommendation: Implement a navigation extension point (e.g. application-registered nav items or organization-scoped links) or disable the platform demo navigation for application-owned pages. This is a platform contract change beyond the application-adoption boundary and is tracked as follow-up work.
